---
title: "Teaching modules"
---

Modules are designed to be adapted. Each one should identify its audience, learning outcomes, approximate duration, prerequisites and associated teaching resources.

| Module | Level | Duration | Resources |
|-----------------|------------------:|------------------:|-----------------|
| [Understanding effect sizes](effect-sizes.qmd) | Introductory | 45–60 minutes | Lesson and embedded exercises |

## Planned modules

- Questions, estimands and eligibility criteria
- Searching and screening
- Critical appraisal and causal claims
- Reading forest and orchard plots
- Heterogeneity and generalisation
- Meta-regression and multilevel models
- Alternatives to vote counting
- Reporting and reproducible workflows
- Responsible automation in evidence synthesis

## EU-NESA meta-analysis training

A practical training package for meta-analysis in the agri-food sector,
including slides, worked examples and exercises in R.

[Access the training materials on GitHub](https://github.com/DrMattG/eu-nesa-meta-analysis)
